unit: municipal and industrial water systems and users

last_unobserved_stage: safety tariff acceptance customer receipt and basin recovery
conversion_question: Can reuse growth become safe affordable delivered security?

unit: governments utilities investors industries and communities
evidence: World Bank identifies possible eightfold potable and industrial reuse growth by 2040 and up to 340 billion dollars in potential investment with pricing regulation and finance conditions
last_unobserved_stage: additionality affordability accountability environmental soundness and distribution
conversion_question: Does reuse finance create public water value rather than only bankable capacity?

unit: poor remote communities utilities providers and households
evidence: World Bank governance series includes service-delivery models for unconventional water in poor and remote communities
last_unobserved_stage: functioning service maintenance affordability customary authority and durable access
conversion_question: Can new-water models reach remote users with local control and maintenance?

evidence: IEA reports 12 billion cubic metres of MENA desalinated production in 2024 and projects tripling by 2035 with reverse osmosis expansion
closed_stage: regional strategic dependence and technology transition
